config.comments.bot_satori_secret.satori: The token used to connect to the Satori server. Leave it empty when the server is not configured with authentication.
config.comments.bot_satori.satori_admin_: The IDs or names of the guild roles that are treated as administrators.
config.comments.bot_satori.satori_enable: Whether to listen for messages sent by the bot itself.
config.comments.bot_satori.satori_host: The host address of the Satori server.
config.comments.bot_satori.satori_limite: The reaction emoji ID attached to the message when message processing fails. It needs to be supported by the protocol terminal. Leave it empty to hide it.
config.comments.bot_satori.satori_path: The path prefix of the Satori server API.
config.comments.bot_satori.satori_port: The port of the Satori server.
config.comments.bot_satori.satori_secure: Whether to connect to the Satori server over HTTPS and WSS.
config.comments.bot_satori.satori_timeou: The timeout for calling the Satori API, in seconds.
config.comments.bot_satori.satori_typing: The reaction emoji ID attached to the message while the message is being processed. It needs to be supported by the protocol terminal. Leave it empty to hide it.
